hero.note: The rule under each line is its measure, the pattern the song is written to, with a long stroke at each beat. The dots are the stresses of the speaking voice. The red dot under *Full* is a stress where the measure has no beat. The red ring under *Of*  is a beat that the voice passes over.

klass.label: The class
klass.title: In room 2215, late in the afternoon
klass.say: In the fall of 1941 Auden taught a course at the University of Michigan called *Fate and the Individual in European Literature*. His students recorded what he said, what he wrote on the blackboard, the records he played and the work he asked for.
